newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Lions eat illegal immigrants in S.African park.
newsitem.headline: Lions eat illegal immigrants in S.African park.

text.p: Lions have eaten at least two Mozambicans who tried to sneak into South Africa through the popular Kruger National Park, rangers said on Thursday.
Torn and bloody clothes -- a blouse, skirt, trousers and shoes that indicated at least one man and woman had been eaten -- were found along with human bones, a Johannesburg radio station added.
Park officials said one of four Mozambicans, who braved the borderland Belgium-sized park to evade detection as they tried to enter the country illegally, escaped by climbing up a tree.
He later made it to safety and alerted authorities to Tuesday night's incident. The fate of the fourth member of the group was uncertain.

Soldiers patrol the Kruger's fenced border with South Africa's impoverished neighbour Mozambique but migrants seeking a better life still make it through for the perilous journey of at least a couple of days' walk across the park.
No one knows how many succeed, or how many get killed.
